item.title: Next lifts profit guidance after warm weather drives Q2 sales beat
item.summary: Next has again raised its full-year profit guidance after second-quarter sales came in well ahead of its own forecasts, helped by a warm UK summer and a rebound in overseas demand. The market should expect a sales beat and an upgrade to guidance from Next.
